text:
maria: Heads-up: PR #19999 is green locally but CI has 1 flaky lane. Need to land before midnight deploy-freeze. Rebase required. Who can give a quick approval? cc @lee @josh

ci-bot: CI summary: 12/13 lanes passed. failure: windows-integration on network-timeout. Rerun recommended: `ci run --rerun 19999 --lane windows-integration`

lee: I can rebase + force-push in 10m if you want. can someone ping me when tests are stable?

josh: I'll queue a rerun now. ETA ~8m. If it flakes again we should fallback to canary-only rollout.

sasha: Quick question on the config change in configs/auth.yaml — need a second set of eyes on the keys change. @maria can you paste the diff?

maria: sure, small diff:
```
- old_key: enabled
+ new_key: enabled
+ migrate: true
```

sasha: LGTM for semantics but can we add a comment above `migrate: true`? tiny nit, not blocking.

lee: Rebase done, pushed. Triggering rerun: `ci trigger 19999`

ci-bot: Rerun started. current status: 4/13 lanes complete, 4 passed, 0 failed so far.

deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy-freeze starts 2026-03-19 00:00 PST. If merge goes past freeze, we'll hold until 05:00.

josh: Tests passed on rerun. All lanes green. @sasha can you approve so we can merge before freeze?

sasha: Approved. :thumbsup: left a small comment on docs.

maria: Merging now. If anything pops up we can revert. Thanks all.

deploy-bot: Merge recorded. Canaries scheduled for 00:10 PST.
